title: Global Nearest Neighbor Multi Object Tracker
source_docs: Sensor Fusion and Tracking Toolbox/Multi-Object Tracking Algorithms/Global_Nearest_Neighbor_Multi_Object_Tracker.md
text: Multi-sensor, multi-object tracker using GNN assignment, 5 inputs, 4 outputs, {Assignment algorithm name} sets Assignment algorithm name; {Tracker identifier} sets the unique tracker identifier, {Filter initialization function}, {Maximum number of tracks}, {Maximum number of sensors}, {Out-of-sequence measurements handling}, {Maximum number of OOSM steps}, {Track state parameters} sets the parameters of track state reference frame, {Update track state parameters with time}, {Enable memory management}, {Name of ’Custom’ assignment function} sets the custom assignment function name character, {Threshold for assigning detections to tracks}, {Cluster tracks and detections for assignment}, {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted, {Type of track confirmation and deletion logic} sets the confirmation and deletion logic type, {Confirmation threshold [M N]} sets the track confirmation threshold for history logic, {Deletion threshold [P Q]} sets the track deletion threshold for history logic, {Confirmation threshold [positive scalar]} sets the track confirmation threshold for score, {Deletion threshold [negative scalar]} sets the track deletion threshold for score logic, {Probability of detection used for track score}, {Rate of false positives used for track score} sets the probability of false alarm used for track score, {Volume of the sensor’s detection bin} sets the volume of sensor detection bin, {Rate of new tracks per unit volume}, {Prediction time source} sets the source of prediction time, {Enable cost matrix input} enables input port for cost matrix, {Enable detectable track IDs input}, {Enable tentative tracks output} enables output port for tentative tracks, {Enable all tracks output} enables output port for all tracks, {Enable information output} enables output port for analysis, {Source of output bus name} sets the source of output track bus name, {Source of output info bus name}, {Maximum number of detections per sensor}, {Maximum number of detections per cluster}, {Maximum number of tracks per cluster} and {Handle run-time violation of cluster size}. Values come from the instance.
